notes.title: Patch 2.14
notes.content:
Patch 2.14 has arrived!

Patch log:
-Fixed issue where Players were getting stuck on some of the furniture.
-Minor text changes.
-Added interactions with fireplaces as an alternative solution for one of the puzzles.
-Added music volume slider in the main menu.

Thank you for all your feedback and support!

notes.title: Patch 2.13
notes.content:
Patch 2.13 is out!

-Fixed issue where Players were getting stuck in the hall.

Thank you for all your feedback and support!

notes.title: Patch 2.12
notes.content:
Patch 2.12 is out!

Patch log:
-Minor text corrections in Main Menu and dialogue.
-Fixed issue where Players were getting stuck in the storage room.
-Fixed issue with overlapping dialogue in last scene when dialogue with Mr. Turtle has not completed.

Thank you for all your feedback and support!

notes.title: Patch 2.11
notes.content:
Patch 2.11 has arrived!

Patch log:

-Fixed issue where Players were getting stuck in the storage room.
-Fixed issue with interaction with Globe in the Office.
-Fixed issue with making some choices in the Red Hall and getting a permanent black screen. 
-Added continue button in main menu when Players complete the game. The continue button will load the last scene to watch the second ending.

Thank you for all your feedback and support!
